_comment: Maps ownership areas to required Azure certifications. Used by Herald's team readiness agent.
_supersedes_note: Microsoft certification hierarchy — a senior credential satisfies the requirement for the junior certs it supersedes. The adjudicator uses this to reject FALSE certification conflicts (a 'gap' an equivalent cert already covers).

auth-service.rationale: Auth service changes carry security risk — AZ-500 (Security Engineer) and SC-300 (Identity Admin) required to safely review and operate identity-layer changes.

api-gateway.rationale: API gateway changes affect developer contracts and CI/CD pipelines. AZ-204 (Developer) and AZ-400 (DevOps) certify engineers to manage these safely.

data-layer.rationale: Database schema and migration changes require DP-203 (Data Engineer) proficiency to prevent data loss or corruption.

web-frontend.rationale: Frontend changes to developer-facing surfaces should be handled by AZ-204 (Developer) certified engineers.

infrastructure.rationale: Infrastructure and CI/CD changes require AZ-400 (DevOps Expert) and AZ-104 (Administrator) to prevent environment regressions.

core-service.rationale: Core service changes require baseline AZ-204 (Developer Associate) proficiency for safe operation.

docs.rationale: Documentation changes have no certification requirements.
